text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all her hard work leading<n>up to this point,
Grass Wonder claims<n>victory.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her sights are now set on the Arima<n>Kinen where a
clash with<n>Maruzensky awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, El Condor Pasa leaves<n>the venue in a
hurry, almost as if<n>running away from Grass
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Emotions whirl as the winds grow<n>colder. Winter is
on the horizon, but<n>Grass Wonder's classic year is
far<n>from over yet...
